caption: Imagine every animal on Earth could talk for just 24 hours. Your dog would finally tell you how it feels when you leave for work, and some dogs already understand a lot: a border collie named Chaser learned the names of more than 1,000 toys. Cows form close friendships and get stressed when they're separated from their favourite companion. Pigeons can tell individual humans apart by their faces. And the mosquito buzzing in your ear at 10 PM is always a female, because she needs the protein in blood to make her eggs. One day of talking animals would be hilarious, and a little terrifying. Which animal would roast YOU first? 👇
